renderings.value: I inferred from her expression that she was angry.
EQ is an indicator of emotional intelligence, which measures how well you perceive your emotions and those of others, and how well you control your emotions.

Yuta knew that it was Aoi, not Toru, who had broken the expensive plate at the store, but he understood why Toru had covered for Aoi, and so he decided not to say anything on the matter and keep it to himself.
